extra.reason: Added README (description, status, unofficial / not-affiliated statement, safety notice, .beads note), MIT LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md with Unreleased section, CONTRIBUTING.md (compatibility report fields, code rules, safety and IP rules). Docs-only: no Makefile exists yet (7v5.2), so there was no devkitPro build or make test to run. Issue template filed as gauge-boy-7v5.14.

Added Makefile (devkitPro 3DS application template; target gaugeboy, all source/ subfolders, romfs, -std=gnu11 -Wextra; 'make test' bypasses devkitPro and runs tests/ on the host), source/main.c (APT_CheckNew3DS check with unsupported-device screen and exit on Old 3DS, osSetSpeedupEnable(true), startup safety notice, exit by touch or START), source/version.h (0.0.0), folder layout from CLAUDE.md, tests/ hand-rolled harness (CHECK, CHECK_EQ_INT, CHECK_EQ_STR, RUN_TEST) with a version suite. Verified: make builds gaugeboy.3dsx with no warnings in devkitpro/devkitarm; make test passes on macOS clang and in the image's gcc; a failing CHECK exits 1; make clean works. Not yet run on real hardware.

Added .github/workflows/build.yml: on every branch push and PR, runs make test then make in the devkitpro/devkitarm container and uploads gaugeboy.3dsx as artifact gaugeboy-3dsx. Verified on GitHub: run 43552773831 on main (842d026) succeeded with the artifact uploaded; run 43552800204 on a temporary branch with a deliberately failing test failed at 'Host unit tests' and skipped the build (branch deleted afterwards).

Added source/elm327/elm327.{h,c} (platform-free): elm_io_t interface for transport, elm_command (flush stale input, send cmd+CR, read to '>' with deadline, drop bytes after prompt, keep reading past buffer overflow to stay in sync), elm_parse_reply (strip NUL/garbage bytes, split CR/LF, trim, upper-case, drop echo / blank / SEARCHING / BUS INIT OK lines, classify ?, NO DATA, UNABLE TO CONNECT, BUS INIT ERROR, CAN ERROR, STOPPED and other adapter errors), elm_startup (ATZ 5 s, ATE0, ATL0, ATSP0 with OK checks, adapter id), elm_read_voltage (ATRV), elm_read_protocol (ATDPN). Tests: 40 elm327 tests with a scripted fake adapter on a simulated clock (echo on, missing prompt, 1-byte split reads, blank lines, lower case, garbage bytes, timeouts, closed connection, stale bytes, overflow). Verified: make test passes with macOS clang and the image's gcc, clean under ASan/UBSan, 12/12 deliberate driver mutations caught; devkitPro build has no warnings. Also replaced the harness's fixed message buffers with gb_check_failf (gcc -Wformat-truncation failed the build).

Added source/transport/tcp_transport.{h,c}: non-blocking BSD-socket TCP transport (libctru soc on 3DS, POSIX on host) with connect timeout via poll + SO_ERROR, TCP_NODELAY, write-all with 1 s timeout, read with timeout, peer-close / error detection that drops the connection, ensure_connected with immediate first reconnect then 0.5-8 s doubling backoff, elm_io_t adapter for the driver, monotonic clock (svcGetSystemTick on 3DS). source/transport/net{.h,_3ds.c}: soc service init/exit with a 1 MB aligned buffer. Tests: 11 host tests against a scripted local TCP server thread (elm_command end to end over TCP, read timeout, peer close, reconnect after drop, refused, bounded connect timeout, backoff doubling/cap/reset). Verified: 53/53 with macOS clang and Linux gcc (10 repeated runs), 25 repeated runs clean under ASan/UBSan, 6/6 transport mutations caught, 3DS build no warnings. Real-3DS checks (wrong IP, adapter unplug, lid close) added to gauge-boy-7v5.11; wiring notes added to gauge-boy-7v5.7.

Added the M0 spike app. source/spike_ui.c (3DS): safety notice then text consoles, log on top (timestamped, wrapped, scrollable via OLDER/NEWER buttons or D-pad/L/R), 8 bottom touch buttons of 19x6 console cells = 152x48 px (CONNECT, ATZ, ATSP0+0100, ATDPN, ATRV, 0902 VIN, OLDER, NEWER) with flash and busy colors, worker thread (LightLock/LightEvent queue) running actions so the UI never blocks, log file sdmc:/3ds/gaugeboy/spike-log.txt appended with a session header. source/spike_actions.c (platform-free): button actions over tcp_transport + elm327 with auto-connect, backoff messages, reply lines, escaped raw bytes, timings, protocol name and voltage. source/data/config.c (config.ini parser/loader/default writer), source/data/textlog.c (wrapping ring log), elm_protocol_name and elm_escape_raw. Tests: 70 total incl. spike actions end to end over TCP to a scripted adapter, config and textlog; clang + gcc, 20 sanitizer runs, 12 mutations caught (one as a hang, so CI now has timeout-minutes: 15). 3DS build no warnings. Not yet run on a 3DS or against the ELM327-emulator package: smoke-test steps added to 7v5.11, emulator check noted on 7v5.6.

textlog_add now wraps after the last word that fits (fit()), drops trailing spaces at breaks and leading spaces on continuation lines, and hard-splits only when there is no space or the only space is in the first third of the line (keeps timestamps like '[   0.485]' and long hex dumps sane). 5 new tests incl. the exact Azahar lines; 75/75 on clang and gcc; 3DS build clean; checked in Azahar: 'Join its' / 'Wi-Fi in System Settings,' and 'connecting to' / '127.0.0.1:35000 ...'.

Added tools/run-emulator.sh (creates tools/.venv on first run, installs ELM327-emulator==4.0.0 from tools/requirements-dev.txt, starts it on 127.0.0.1:35000 with the 'car' scenario: CAN 11/500 = ATDPN A6, CEL, DTC modes, bank 1 trims, MAP, VIN; --lan, ELM_PORT, ELM_SCENARIO), tools/emulator_check.c + 'make emulator-check' (driver startup, 0100, ATDPN = 6, ATRV, 0902 and all spike actions over TCP, PASS/FAIL, exit code), tools/README.md (start, check, Azahar and real-3DS use, limits). Verified: fresh-venv first run, emulator-check ALL PASSED on 'default' and 'car' scenarios, and the spike app in Azahar ran ATZ / ATSP0+0100 / ATDPN / ATRV / 0902 against the emulator (covers the 7v5.7 emulator acceptance). make test 75/75 on clang and gcc, 3DS build clean. Follow-ups: gauge-boy-3n6.1 (bank 2 trims scenario for M2), gauge-boy-7v5.16 (spike header truncation).

Header text moved to platform-free spike_format_header() in spike_actions.c and shortened to 'GaugeBoy <ver>  [CONNECTED]  BUSY: <label>' (longest 45 of 49 cols); out-of-range busy values show no label. 2 new tests check every connected/busy state fits SPIKE_HEADER_COLS (== TEXTLOG_COLS) and the exact text; the old format fails them at 51 chars. 77/77 on clang and gcc, 3DS build clean, checked in Azahar: '[offline]  BUSY: ATSP0+0100' and '[CONNECTED]  BUSY: ATZ' show in full.

Added .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/compatibility-report.yml (GitHub issue form, label 'compatibility'): GaugeBoy version, adapter brand/model, ELM327 version, IP:port, Wi-Fi security and mode (ad-hoc noted as unsupported), manual IP needed, console model, system/Luma version, vehicle, ATDPN protocol, checkboxes for each M0 check (join Wi-Fi, CONNECT, ATZ x10, 0100, ATRV, VIN, lid reconnect), problems, log excerpt (spike-log.txt), notes, and a required parked/passenger safety confirmation. CONTRIBUTING.md links to it. YAML checked structurally (caught and fixed an unquoted ': ' that GitHub would reject); make test 77/77, 3DS build clean. Spike logs 'Network: <Wi-Fi state, SSID, slot, 3DS IP>' at start-up and before each connect (net_describe via libctru ac + gethostid; optional spike_t.net_info hook). Transport stores errno as positive (tp_normalize_errno), so libctru's -ENETDOWN reads 'errno 115: Network interface is not configured'. Tests: 81 pass; devkitPro .3dsx and .cia build with no warnings.

CONNECT/auto-reconnect call net_up (spike_t hook) -> net_bring_up on 3DS: if ACU_GetWifiStatus is 0, ACU_ConnectAsync with default config, network area 2, all slots, EULA version (as Luma3DS Rosalina), waits up to 20 s, reads GetConnectResult (raw IPC 0x5) and ac last error codes; ac session kept open. Transport records last_step (socket()/fcntl()/connect()/poll()/send()/recv()), logged as 'errno N at step'. net_describe slot numbering fixed (bit 0 = slot 1) and shows ac result codes. Test guide troubleshooting updated. 79 host tests pass; .3dsx and .cia build with no warnings. Not yet tried on hardware: result goes on gauge-boy-7v5.11.

tcp_transport_connect: after poll, SO_ERROR on the 3DS is mapped with tp_3ds_soc_errno (Horizon table from libctru soc_common.c; 26 = EINPROGRESS); in-progress re-checks with connect() (0/EISCONN = connected) and keeps waiting in 20 ms steps until the deadline, then TP_ERR_TIMEOUT 'Adapter did not answer'. Host test for the mapping; 80 host tests pass; .3dsx and .cia build with no warnings. Hardware result goes on gauge-boy-7v5.22.
